method: Claude Haiku read each retreat's name, description, teachers and up to 8 talk titles against the category list (pass/GUIDE.md); Claude Sonnet audited a random sample and every retreat Haiku gave none or four or more, and its reading wins. On 2026-11-02 Dzogchen & Mahāmudrā and Gazing were split in four (pass/split.jsonl, Claude Haiku re-reading the 23 retreats they touch). On 2026-11-03 Vipassanā was narrowed to retreats whose practice is insight (pass/GUIDE.md): Claude Haiku re-read its 1,578 retreats (pass/vipassana/), and Claude Sonnet re-read a random 300 and every retreat Haiku kept (pass/vipassana-audit.jsonl), its reading winning; after review, Sonnet re-read affinity retreats (judged on their practice, not their audience) and retreats with no description, with every talk title (pass/vipassana-reread.jsonl).
